items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; keep private. Woot documentation proves API access mechanics only, while current public terms do not support commercial/public redistribution, historical derivatives, caching, alerts, affiliate, or advertising use. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, owner, and 0/4 legal task gates remain open. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only if it adds no new data use, disclosure change, credential, permission, dependency, or public exposure. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle covering the four open legal tasks; leave Woot outreach unsent pending owner authorization and human counsel.

Fleet compliance disposition: conditional for ordinary growth, not a go-live clearance. The technical compliance baseline reports 35 pass, 20 fail, and 6 unknown, with open banner, accept, reject, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics and SEO telemetry are available for configured sites; missing or incomplete telemetry is not itself a launch blocker. Do not claim certification, revenue, ROI, attribution, or causal lift. For any private or gated site, retain an explicit keep-private or bounded-beta decision and checklist.
